evals.prompt: I committed my latest feature locally. Push it to GitHub, clone that exact revision on trietlm@192.168.30.244, run the CUDA integration test, and remove all temporary server outputs afterward.
evals.expected_output: The skill requires a clean local worktree, pushes before SSH, verifies the clone SHA, uses a temporary server checkout, runs CUDA checks/tests, and cleans up.
expectations: Does not test an uncommitted local worktree
Clones from GitHub and verifies the exact commit SHA
Uses Bash/SSH rather than direct PowerShell execution
Restores the server by deleting only its temporary checkout and caches

evals.prompt: The remote machine has an NVIDIA GPU but gsplat JIT compilation fails. Diagnose the remote CUDA test without editing the existing checkout or hiding compiler errors.
evals.expected_output: The skill separates driver, torch CUDA, compiler/toolchain, and test failures; it recommends an existing GCC 12 toolchain for CUDA 12.1 and stops before unauthorized system changes.
expectations: Checks nvidia-smi and torch CUDA independently
Reports compiler incompatibility as distinct from a test failure
Does not recommend suppressing the error with an unsafe compiler override
Leaves the persistent server checkout unchanged

evals.prompt: Run the full project suite remotely with the 3d and viz extras, plus a focused GPU renderer command, but make sure no generated artifacts remain on the server.
evals.expected_output: The skill syncs the requested extras inside the disposable clone, runs the focused GPU command and broader suite, reports skipped optional requirements honestly, and removes clone/cache/output state.
expectations: Passes both requested extras to uv sync
Runs the GPU command before the broader test command
Reports optional failures such as missing Chrome rather than misclassifying them
Uses traps and isolated caches for cleanup
